paper.title: RLVE: Scaling Up Reinforcement Learning for Language Models with Adaptive Verifiable Environments
paper.central_claim: 使用400个手工设计的可验证环境和按policy能力自适应的难度课程，改善RL训练效率与训练后语言模型的跨环境推理能力。

provenance.notes: Opus aggregate seat via the configured claude-kimi type fable; no route probing. actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are null because the subagent runtime exposes no verifiable provider receipt to this worker.

sections_read: Opus: complete pinned text read end-to-end (abstract, all sections, tables, appendices) before opening seat records; targeted re-reads for every disputed field

evidence.locator: Abstract, adaptive difficulty and evaluated outcome
evidence.quote: enables each verifiable environment to dynamically adapt its problem difficulty distribution to the policy model’s capabilities as training progresses.
evidence.support_explanation: 反馈调整训练题目难度；被改善对象是 RL policy，不是持久化部署 harness。

evidence.quote: We perform one parameter update after each rollout step.
evidence.support_explanation: 实际更新政策模型参数。

evidence.quote: We therefore consider the substantial human effort our authors devoted to manually engineering all 400 environments to be worthwhile.
evidence.support_explanation: 生成器/验证器由人手工开发，并非执行反馈闭环编辑。

evidence.quote: can serve as a prototype for future research on automatic environment engineering, analogous to how prior studies employed LMs for automatic data generation starting from a seed dataset
evidence.support_explanation: 非权重环境代码自动演化是未来研究而非本文已评估留存对象。

evidence.quote: yields a 3.37% absolute average improvement across six reasoning benchmarks, starting from one of the strongest 1.5B reasoning LMs.
evidence.support_explanation: The reported retained improvement is in the policy model's benchmark performance, i.e. the product is trained weights.

evidence.quote: Any algorithm applicable to RLVR can be directly applied to RLVE
evidence.support_explanation: Learning update is a standard weight-updating RL algorithm (DAPO/GRPO variant); RLVE is an environment/data layer for it.

evidence.quote: is considered proficient at this difficulty level, and the upper bound is incremented by one
evidence.support_explanation: The only feedback-driven non-weight state is a per-environment difficulty upper bound incremented when rollout accuracy passes a threshold; it is reset-free scalar training state inside one run, not a retained prompt/skill/tool/workflow/memory/evaluator.

evidence.quote: In our preliminary explorations, we tried employing frontier LMs to perform automatic environment engineering.
evidence.support_explanation: Environment construction is not performed by the system from execution feedback; automatic environment engineering was tried and not adopted.

evidence.quote: In contrast, RLVE grounds environment adaptation in controllable manual construction, avoiding potentially incorrect LM-generated problems or verifiers.
evidence.support_explanation: Author explicitly separates RLVE from LM-generated (self-evolving) environments; the 400 environments are static human-written programs.

evidence.quote: enables each verifiable environment to dynamically adapt its problem difficulty distribution to the policy model’s capabilities as training progresses
evidence.support_explanation: Adaptation is of the training-problem distribution, during training.
The only adaptive state: a scalar range per environment, raised on accuracy ≥ 90%.
Environments are human-built, not produced from execution feedback.

signatures.object: 训练环境难度区间和语言模型policy权重
signatures.information: 每环境当前上界难度的rollout正确率、样本计数
signatures.operation: 达到最小采样数且正确率达阈值则增加上界、按窗口移动下界；按区间采样问题，运行DAPO参数更新
signatures.output: 训练后policy及训练内课程状态
signatures.conditions: 固定人工编写的generator/verifier；正确率阈值0.9、窗口4；RL训练
signatures.selection_rule: 上界正确率阈值控制课程；梯度更新policy
signatures.persistence: 课程难度范围在训练步骤之间保留；未报告将反馈编辑的非权重harness作为独立部署和评估产物
signatures.later_use: 后续RL步骤继续生成题目，最终评估训练后权重
signatures.failure_boundary: 固定环境课程调节与权重训练不等于已实现非权重组件自演化；自动环境工程是未来工作

gap.author_gap: 静态题目分布过易/过难使学习信号消失；可验证RL数据有限。
gap.checked_gap: 论文确实评估自适应课程对权重训练的作用，但不回答本雷达非权重留存对象问题。
gap.residue: 自适应环境课程训练，不是harness演化证据。
gap.stakes: RL训练效率与泛化；不在本次范围内评分。
gap.method_response: 按policy成功率调整生成难度与多环境训练。
gap.remaining_gap: 未实现/评估自动保留环境代码修改。

claims.text: 自适应可验证环境改善RL后的LM推理能力
claims.setting: 400固定手工环境；DAPO训练与外部推理基准
claims.baseline/control: 静态课程、原RL训练延续（作者报告）
claims.selection_vs_test: 课程由训练rollout反馈更新，最终测量训练后policy
claims.result/denominator: 范围排除，不在此复评其数值主张
claims.allowed_conclusion: 有反馈驱动课程，并不单独证明非权重harness留存收益。

assessment.evidence_level_note: No harness evidence label for an out-of-scope weight-level paper (run convention r05b/r06a/r07a/r08a).
assessment.claim_support_note: Not assessed under this rubric; RL gains are author-reported checkpoint results.
unresolved: Out-of-scope disposition is not a judgment that the RL results are wrong.

G.reason: out_of_scope (rubric A3 bullet 1; both seats, independently re-checked). RLVE keeps a per-environment difficulty window that rises when the policy's accuracy passes a threshold (opus:O02), but that window only controls which problems are generated as RL training data; the 400 environments are hand-engineered and fixed (opus:O03); and every result is a trained checkpoint evaluated on held-out environments or reasoning benchmarks (opus:O04). The improver's update target and evaluated product are weights — same ruling as r08a ASL / r02a WebRL (curriculum or training data for weights). Not scored; null is not a zero-quality rating.
